name: pulse-presence
geometry: An 8px dot in the corner of an icon pulses scale 1.00 → 1.25 → 1.00 every 2s, signaling 'live' state. Under reduce-motion, the dot STILL pulses — but at a slower rhythm (4s) and without the scale interpolation, using only opacity 0.6 → 1.0. The rhythm IS the meaning; collapsing the rhythm would erase the live/offline distinction.
rationale: Tier 3 is non-negotiable: the motion IS the information. Without it, the live indicator becomes a static dot indistinguishable from a settings glyph. This is the strongest test of the tier system.
antiPatterns: Tier-3 collapse to opacity-only under reduce (the lossy version)
Tier-3 remove under reduce (the wrong version — erases meaning)
Continuous pulse without a context (every AI default does this)
testNote: If the reduce strategy is not 'keep', the tier system is broken and the whole contract must be redesigned before v0.1.0 ships.
